caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative plate, shown from both a top-down and a side profile view. The plate is illustrated in blue and gray tones on an off-white or light beige background. The top-down view is positioned in the upper half of the image, showing a circular plate with ornate, scalloped edges. The rim of the plate is decorated with floral and scroll motifs, as well as star symbols and an eagle at the top. The center of the plate contains an image of a ship with three masts and sails, along with the American flag at the stern and water beneath. Around the ship, within the inner circle of the plate, there is some text that appears to read "AMERICAN INDEPENDENCE 1776." The lower half of the drawing features a side view of the plate, revealing its shallow, dish-like shape and further detailing the decorated rim, including a pattern of leaves and scrolls that echo the design seen from above. The entire composition is focused on the details and form of the plate, without any extraneous objects present.
title: Cup Plate
